decision: S2 fallback band pre-registration (lead, promotion authority)
registered: exact one-sided 95% LB >= -2pp AND point estimate >= -0.5pp (in place of the unpowerable -1pp band; the 1pp band required n~2,667 vs 307 available — 21% power per the design doc)
rationale: a 1.29x paired CPU-cycle speedup against a bounded <=2pp exact dip is the product-relevant trade for the CPU serving tier; the pilot point estimate (-0.39pp) sits inside the band; all other gates (valid >=-2pp, noop <= Q8, intent >= 0, cycle >= 1.15x both ctx, drift <=3%) unchanged from the design
consequence: any gate miss retains Q8_0 and closes S2; inconclusive != parity
